name: requeue-same-job-id
rule: a retry gets its own delivery id; a queue ignores an add whose id already exists
covers: A retry is enqueued under a new id per attempt
message: retry failed sync jobs through the queue
body: A sync job that throws is added back to the queue after RETRY_DELAY_MS, up to MAX_ATTEMPTS. The job id is kept on the retry so every attempt shows under one job in the dashboard.
